name: Park Hyatt Chennai
positioning: City hotel on Velachery Road beside Guindy National Park, designed by George Wong as a 'house of weavers' around a lily-pond courtyard, with a rooftop infinity pool
best_for: Travelers who want a Chennai base beside Guindy National Park with park-view suites
Food lovers who want several restaurants under one roof, from Singaporean hawker-style dishes to show-kitchen dining

facts.text: The hotel is beside Guindy National Park.
The hotel's address is 39 Velachery Road, near Raj Bhavan, Chennai.
Antahpura Spa has steam and sauna facilities along with hot and cold plunge pools.
The fitness centre, The Sphere, is on the top floor, with floor-to-ceiling windows and city views.
At The Flying Elephant, food is served from show kitchens around the dining floor.
Mr. Ong serves Singaporean hawker-style dishes rooted in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.
Park Brasserie is the all-day-dining restaurant, set next to the lily pond.
Dogs are welcome through the 'Paws at the Park' program, with rooms dedicated to guests travelling with dogs.
Kapaleeshwarar and Ashtalakshmi temples and Marina Beach can be visited from the hotel.
The Apartment is a residential-style event venue with handcrafted furniture and art installations.

highlights.text: The hotel was designed by hotel architect George Wong as a 'house of weavers'.
A rooftop infinity pool overlooks Guindy National Park.
The Presidential Suite has a private massage table and plunge pool in its bath area.
Rooms and suites surround a lily pond in the hotel's inner courtyard.
The Flying Elephant is a multi-level dining destination.

considerations.text: Chennai International Airport is 10 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack beachfront access.
